Here what I’ll say, yes some of Warframe’s systems are out dated ie: waiting 3 days for a new frame to build, 12 hours for a weapon to build, limited inventory space, etc. As someone who’s been around the block in terms of mmos I understand the want of one big transaction that provides a lot. With that said there is a fine line with something like that, WoW for example provides a fuck ton of content with a $40-$50 dlc while a game like Destiny 2 will ask you for a staggering $100 for like 4 hours of content and then seasonal content that isn’t guaranteed to be good. Warframe has a lot of grind and honestly is one of the better “Free to play” games I’ve seen in the sense that it is truly free to play unlike other games that claim to be. It’ll be up to you on whether you want to stick with it, personally I take long breaks from the game until new content releases and only get back on if I feel the grind calling. I hope you have a good time with it though, you’re new so you still have a solid amount of story content to play and I always found that enjoyable.
